Studio.Subtitle: Prepare an OMRL recipe and review its plan without changing a real game installation.
Studio.StageDescription.GameSource: Choose a game, an optional game-version range, and recipe file sources.
Studio.StageDescription.Loader: Add the required mod loader and pin its artifact and version.
Studio.StageDescription.Files: Arrange file operations, optional variant rules, and post-install verification.
Studio.StageDescription.Plan: Compare plans for example installations, validate rules, and prepare an OMRL export.
Studio.LoaderHelp: Each mod-loader variant is a separate operation with a pinned artifact. Store, architecture, and build conditions are serialized as standard OMRL rules.
Studio.FilesHelp: Operations run in list order. Reorder or remove them, and add installation conditions when needed.
Studio.AdvancedConditionPreserved: This OMRL rule has an additional condition. It is preserved while other fields are edited.
Studio.GameRequired: Select a game for this recipe.
Studio.SourceRequired: Add at least one file source.
Studio.LoaderRequired: Add at least one mod-loader operation before continuing.
Studio.FileOperationRequired: Add at least one file preparation operation.
Studio.ValidationUnexpectedError: The draft could not be validated. Check the fields and try again.
Studio.SampleInstallNote: These are example installation facts, not data detected on this computer.
Studio.PlanHelp: OperationPlanner calculates each plan in a temporary fixture directory. Game files are never read or changed.
Studio.DownloadRequired: The plan requires the artifact to be downloaded before installation.
Studio.PlanUnexpectedError: The example plan could not be prepared. Check operation and rule compatibility.
Studio.AdvancedDescription: Edit the shared draft directly. Reordering operations is reflected in OMRL.
Studio.CopySuccess: Copied the OMRL preview to the clipboard.
Studio.CopyUnavailable: The clipboard is unavailable in this window.
Studio.CopyFailed: Could not copy the OMRL preview.
Studio.ExportHint: Export always saves a valid .omrl file. Publishing requires a device identity and server support for OMRL recipes.
Studio.ReleaseValidationFailed: Fix the validation errors first; the draft was not exported.
Studio.ExportSuccessNoSigner: OMRL file exported. Publishing requires an online, registered device identity.
Studio.ExportSuccessPublishUnavailable: OMRL file exported. The current package API publishes modpacks, not OMRL recipes.
Studio.ExportCanceled: OMRL export was canceled or is unavailable in this window.
Studio.ExportFailed: Could not export the OMRL file.
Graph.SampleNote: Example dependency graph. Names, versions, and conflicts demonstrate the view; they do not confirm compatibility with a real installation.
Graph.InBlockingPair: This version is part of a pair that blocks installation.
Graph.BlockingPairHelp: These pinned versions cannot run together in this example scenario. Choose a compatible variant and review the plan again.
